resources.string: Each check below removes a common way alarms get silenced on modern Android.
Keep XX Clock OUT of Nope-Mode\'s blocked app list. Nope-Mode suspends packages — a suspended clock cannot ring.
Shows the alarm alert and lets you snooze or dismiss straight from the notification shade.
Lets an alarm fire at the exact minute instead of being deferred to a later maintenance window.
Exact access is off: your armed alarms will fire within about a 10-minute window until it is restored.
Alarm sound and vibration break through even while Do Not Disturb is on.
Wakes the screen and shows the alarm over the lock screen, so you never sleep through it.
Stops aggressive battery savers from killing the ringing service in the background.
The family presets — the same set the launcher broadcasts. What you set stays set: the system dark-mode setting has no say. Custom reuses the launcher\'s last custom ground.
